identity.product_outcome: A read-mostly cross-ledger integrity observer and defect router that normalizes source-owned repository and external truth into an audit graph, emits attributable durable findings, and localizes integrity failures without mutating the semantic sources it audits.
identity.artist_job: Detect missing, contradictory, stale, orphaned or falsely promoted product/governance/public evidence across N0TE ledgers without letting the auditor become a second authority or silently repair truth.

bounded_increment.description: Preserve the richer runnable P1-E auditor, workflow, contracts and adversarial proof as explicit WAITING residue while the selected #256 trusted integration gate proceeds first.

semantic_contract.required_behavior: Read source-owned repository and supplied external projections without mutating them; normalize a traceable graph; evaluate cataloged integrity invariants; preserve incomplete evidence honestly; emit deterministic durable findings and remediation routing; and localize blocking cones instead of fabricating global truth.
non_negotiable_semantics: the auditor is an observer and defect router, not Main Steward, Builder, scope owner, current-state owner, public executor, rights authority or semantic authority
missing required external evidence yields INCOMPLETE_AUDIT rather than PASS
finding identities and lifecycle remain durable and attributable across runs
open findings do not disappear merely because a later run cannot inspect the required source
only cataloged blocking or critical invariant failures create localized blocking cones
unrelated cones remain outside a localized block
supersession, equivalence, residue and cycle checks preserve explicit successor and coverage truth
merge evidence must never imply public acceptance, human acceptance, provider acceptance or rights clearance
the auditor cannot create, redefine or delete product requirements or incident truth
every supplied semantic or materialized input projection must remain byte-for-byte unchanged before versus after audit, proven by deterministic hashing or equivalent adversarial proof

the stronger minimal P1-E residue from PR #252 remains mandatory, including omitted retained requirements, dangling bridges, missing public handoffs, merge-not-public-acceptance, historical trace warnings without fabricated identifiers, incomplete equivalence failure, WAITING without resurrection or wake conditions, and a fully linked valid sample
allowed_implementation_freedom: internal graph representation when stable source identity and semantics are preserved
event-cone optimization when unknown paths safely fall back to full reconciliation
artifact-retention implementation compatible with current trusted workflow ownership
interpretations_required: The richer observer/auditor is distinct from the selected #256 trusted integration gate: #256 is fail-closed base-owned integration enforcement, while this lane is read-mostly observation, durable findings and remediation routing.
Workflow and automation-registry surfaces make final integration Steward/meta-governance work even though the auditor itself is read-mostly.
remaining_semantics: fresh-main reconstruction after the selected #256 repair reaches its required terminal state
explicit source-immutability adversarial proof must be carried into that reconstruction even if historical candidate code appears read-only
